text: 3. **The FlatBuffers-generated Swift types are stale — NOT STARTED, this is the big one.** `TypedHomeFeedDecoder.swift` decodes the home feed's typed sidecar using generated types `nmp_nip01_OpFeedSnapshot` / `nmp_nip01_TimelineEventCard` / `nmp_nip01_RootCard` (checked in at `apps/ios/Chirp/Bridge/Generated/OpFeedSnapshot.generated.swift`, `TimelineSnapshot.generated.swift`) and hardcodes `schemaId = "nmp.nip01.opfeed"` / `fileIdentifier = "NOFS"`. All of that is gone: the current pin's actual schema lives at `crates/nmp-note-feed/schema/op_feed.fbs` under `namespace nmp.note_feed;`, with `OP_FEED_SCHEMA_ID = "nmp.note_feed.opfeed"`, `OP_FEED_FILE_IDENTIFIER = "NNFS"`, `OP_FEED_SCHEMA_VERSION = 2` (verified directly in the pinned checkout). The card type itself renamed `TimelineEventCard`→`NoteFeedItem` and changed fields (dropped `relation_counts`, added `hosted_group`). Fixing this means: regenerating the Swift FlatBuffers bindings from the new `.fbs` (I found `flatc` is available locally, haven't run it yet), which will produce a new `nmp_note_feed_*`-prefixed type family, then rewriting `TypedHomeFeedDecoder.swift`'s field-by-field mapping to match. This is a real, multi-file migration of comparable size to what I just finished for tui/desktop/android-ffi — not a quick follow-on to a key rename. [...] - chirp#35 — the cross-platform OP-feed-schema decode migration (`nmp.nip01.opfeed`/`NOFS`/`TimelineEventCard` v1 → `nmp.note_feed.opfeed`/`NNFS`/`NoteFeedItem` v2). Full per-platform inventory in the issue body. [...] chirp#35 (Android): regenerated the stale nmp.nip01.* Kotlin FlatBuffers types as nmp.note_feed.* (schema id nmp.note_feed.opfeed, file id NNFS, v2, card NoteFeedItem) from the pinned NMP schema (crates/nmp-note-feed/schema/op_feed.fbs @ fa49d00c5). Rewrote TypedHomeFeedDecoder.kt and the Chirp*/ model types for the new shape — relation_counts/author_display_name/author_picture_url/content_preview are gone from the wire (dropped for good, not a bug: display data is now component-owned via LocalNostrProfileHost, which TimelineScreen.kt already had a fallback path for), hosted_group is new and wired through. Updated NoteActions.kt so the Reply/React/Repost/Zap buttons work without a counts payload (counts absent is expected per your note, not regressed). Golden-fixture tests (OpFeedDecoderTest, TypedHomeFeedDecoderContractTest) rewritten against nmp-note-feed's real v2 hex fixtures — 19/19 passing. Added apps/android/scripts/regen-flatbuffers.sh closing the no-regen-script gap — and it caught a real landmine: `brew install flatbuffers` installs 25.12.19, but the checked-in Kotlin runtime is pinned to 25.2.10; the wrong flatc silently emits code calling a Constants method that doesn't exist in the pinned runtime. Script now hard-requires the exact version (downloads a matching release binary, doesn't rely on brew).
